comparison_contract: Every cell uses decoded vectors from the checksum-pinned official Cohere Medium 1M train Parquet before starting any durable-ticket timer. Worker-lane count, writer count, and logical-cell count are independent matrix factors and use cyclic per-repetition execution order. Each acknowledgement is the public lane-log durability boundary; drain time is separate. Write/read p95 and inserted-ID visibility apply to every cell; the 10,000 vectors/s burst bulk-ingest gate applies only to the preregistered 32-writer cells and is not a sustained-duration claim. Inserted-ID recall@10 is only a visibility/read-path invariant and is not represented as corpus ANN recall. Three repetitions qualify architecture only; publication requires a separately frozen five-repetition campaign.
